content.comment_body: Hello, I programmed a rotation for the pump with every incoming signal. However, I need to set up a 30-minute delay before making the last activated pump available again.
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. This forum uses English as the main language. Please write future posts in English. Thank you. Also, please update the topic title to English.
Could you provide more details about what you want to achieve specifically?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to implement a control sequence for pump rotation on a [product_name], requiring a method to introduce a 30-minute delay before the recently operated pump can be selected again. The main challenge is configuring advanced timing and exclusion features with the device's available functional blocks.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to use a timer to ensure that the last operated pump remains excluded from rotation for a fixed duration (30 minutes) in their sequence logic.
